title: Theo and the Echo
author: Juniper Vasquez
blurb: Xanthe Eriksen, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
